What is real here and what is not

  • Joybot is drawn from his real sprite sheets. Pulling uses your nine new back-to-camera frames, as they came: centred roughly by me, not yet aligned or reordered. Carrying the scroll uses the nervous oops. The slap is discarding-clip, and he salutes before flying home.
  • The two rooms are sketches of JoyBrush and Studio, not screenshots. On the phone the show uses pictures of your real screens.
  • The warps are written the same way the phone's shaders are, so the motion is a fair guide. The speed is not: nothing here has been measured on the Note 9.
  • The colours are the app's own: JoyBrush's purple to blue, Studio's mint to lime. The tunnel's streaks start in JoyBrush's and give way to Studio's.
  • The new room comes in from the left because Studio sits to the left of JoyBrush on the lobby dial.
